Your spells dealing[1] slow the target. If you are not resistant to[1], you also become slowed.

Bosses can avoid this with a Constitution Saving Throw against your Potency DC, and can be slowed this way no more than once per turn.

Push away anyone and anything by [1], and also slow affected creatures.

Bosses can avoid this with a Constitution Saving Throw against your Potency DC.

All foes smaller than Large within [2] of you are Slowed for [1] turn(s) at the start of their turn.

Bosses can avoid this with a Constitution Saving Throw against your Potency DC.

Toggle feature. Enable to spend Blood Rush charges on attacks, applying Bleeding. If the target already has Bleeding, it also becomes chest wounded.

Bosses can avoid these wounds with a Constitution Saving Throw against your Potency DC.
